Avery Dennison Corporation.note: Avery Dennison Corporation is an independent public company that has acquired other healthcare and materials businesses, rather than being acquired itself.

Covestro AG.note: Covestro AG was acquired by ADNOC's investment subsidiary XRG in 2025.

Fucine Film S.p.A..note: Fucine Film's company shares were transferred to Eriplast, a company owned by the Spezzapria family, in 2018.

J-Film Corporation.note: Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation transferred all of its shares in J-Film Corporation to Marunouchi Capital in 2025.

Mondi plc.note: Mondi plc is an independent global leader in sustainable packaging and paper that acts as an acquirer of other packaging assets.

Plastissimo Film Co., Ltd..note: Plastissimo Film Co., Ltd. continues to operate as an independent advanced flexible packaging barrier film manufacturer in Thailand.

SWM International.note: SWM completed a merger of equals with Neenah, Inc. in 2022 to become Mativ, and its DelStar brand was subsequently retired under the SWM banner.

SÜDPACK Medica AG.note: SÜDPACK Medica AG operates as an independent subsidiary segment of the family-owned SÜDPACK Group.

Verbano Film S.r.l..note: Verbano Film S.r.l. remains an independent Italian cast polypropylene film producer expanding its production capacity under its own name.

Arihant Polymers.note: Arihant Polymers remains an independent, privately held PVC compounding manufacturer based in Chennai, India.

CURE BIOTECH Co., Ltd..note: CURE BIOTECH remains an independent medical biopolymer supplier and established a joint venture with WEGO Group in 2026.

Dongguan Huadai Silicone Co., Ltd..note: Dongguan Huadai Silicone Co., Ltd. operates as an independent manufacturer of solid and compound silicone rubber in China.

Flexon Polybend.note: Flexon Polybend operates as an independent manufacturer of customized plastic granules and PVC compounds in Rajkot, India.

Haldia Petrochemicals Limited.note: Haldia Petrochemicals Limited operates as an independent petrochemicals complex and frequently acts as an acquirer itself.

Jieh-Ming Plastics Mfg. Co., Ltd..note: Jieh-Ming Plastics Mfg. Co., Ltd. remains an independent manufacturer of medical-grade PVC compounds and hoses since 1975.

Lehmann & Voss & Co. KG.note: Lehmann & Voss & Co. KG is an independent chemical specialties supplier and acts as the parent head of the LEHVOSS Group.

Nanjing SiSiB Silicones Co., Ltd..note: Nanjing SiSiB Silicones Co., Ltd. operates under its own brand name as a manufacturing division within the SINOPCC Group.

Polymer Resources Ltd..note: Polymer Resources Ltd. is an independent, privately owned and debt-free US compounder of engineering thermoplastics.

SONGWON Industrial Co., Ltd..note: SONGWON Industrial Co., Ltd. is an independent, publicly traded global developer and manufacturer of polymer stabilizers.

Chengdu Silike Technology Co., Ltd..note: Chengdu Silike Technology Co., Ltd. operates independently as an established innovator and manufacturer of functional silicone materials.

INEOS Styrolution Group GmbH.note: Ineos acquired a majority stake in Lanxess's Lustran polymers business in 2007 to form a joint venture, taking full ownership later.

Nan Ya Plastics Corp..note: Nan Ya Plastics Corp. operates as a major independent manufacturer of plastics, polyester fibers, and electronic materials.

Techmer PM.note: Gryphon Investors acquired a majority stake in Techmer PM in September 2022, with SK Capital and founder John Manuck retaining minority stakes.
